dataset_readme_statement: regular_alt_batteries: cycled at the same load level or load range throughout lifetime; recommissioned_batteries: cycled at different load levels at varying life stages; second_life_batteries: constant current. i.e. the load is assigned per pack (or per pack x life stage), never per mission.

criterion.rule: median over theta of (#action bins with >=5 missions) >= 3

G0.consequence: Psi(theta,pi) is constant in pi by construction; the policy axis, and with it G5 (policy switch), is not estimable on this dataset.
